text:
Nia (People Ops): Quick policy check: booking an Airbnb for a 2-night team working session. One person wants to pay on their personal card and be reimbursed. What do we need to submit?

Carlos (Eng): i'll pay if that helps. what's the minimum proof finance needs?

Meera (Finance): we require the booking confirmation (PDF or email) showing host, dates, and total. For reimbursements, also include proof of payment (card transaction or bank statement snippet showing last4).

Nia (People Ops): add people-ops guidance: include a 1-line business purpose and a short guest list (first names + role). This helps expense classification for audits.

Carlos (Eng): ok. does the company prefer corporate (virtual) card instead?

Meera (Finance): yes — preferred: use company virtual card. If using personal card: payer gets reimbursed. We do not split one reimbursement transaction across multiple employees. If others want direct reimbursement, they must submit their own transfer requests with proof of payment to finance.

TravelBot: Reminder: expenses above $1000 need manager pre-approval before booking. Attach pre-approval email or Slack thread. Upload receipts as PDFs or clear images.

Omar (Manager): FYI i can pre-approve up to $1200 for team offsites; for anything above that we need director sign-off.

Carlos (Eng): what about cleaning fees / service fees / taxes? Airbnb lumps them together sometimes.

Meera (Finance): reimbursable as lodging when they are part of the host invoice. If fees are bundled with no breakdown, include the Airbnb confirmation page screenshot. If trip is in EU/UK, include VAT details if present — we try to recover VAT where possible.

Nia (People Ops): also note per-diem: you may choose per-diem for meals or submit actual meal receipts, but not both. Travel day rules in the policy page.

Carlos (Eng): thanks. i'll book with company card if available, otherwise i'll pay and upload confirmation + payment proof + one-line guest list.

Meera (Finance): perfect. Tag @meera when you submit and i'll expedite.

Nia (People Ops): i'll pin a short checklist in #travel with the steps and required attachments. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
